_comment: Club constants. NEVER hardcode these in templates. Sources: normiesyachtclub.com/llms.txt, /api/v1/*, official LOG of @NormieYachtClub.

claim.note: After the close a yacht not claimed is never built: the fleet IS the yachts afloat, and it can only shrink (a forge burns ten and mints one). The code reads mintOpen() on the contract; these dates are the fallback, from llms.txt and RELAY /claims/status, read 19 Oct 2026.

anchorPoints.note: Off-chain club ledger. Not a token, no contract. Earned by holding.

chandlery._source: Live catalog at RELAY /chandlery, read 1 Sep 2026. The relay is authoritative; these are the fallback.

daily.note: One token marked by an unforeseeable block - a yacht or, since islands exist, an island (island #1000000 was marked on 17 Oct 2026). Mark is permanent.
daily.misses: A draw can end marking nobody even with entries in it - the relay publishes those days with yachtId null and the club does not say why. Never invent a reason for one.
daily.published: Only the most recent draw carries its block and hash (RELAY /tide/daily, field last). The history rows carry neither, so they are not republishable.
daily.acceptsBoth: One signature can enter the daily draw and keep the Regatta watch together (RELAY /tide/daily acceptsBoth). The log signs nothing; it only reads the result.

sunday.prizes: NFTs only since 4 September 2026. Moorings, naming rights and Tide Marks have left the Tide: the Regatta hands out standing, the Tide hands out property.
sunday.note: Captains are counted, never yachts. Three float a round, thirty make it hand out two prizes instead of one, and a captain who wins leaves the pool with every yacht they entered - so a second prize is drawn from a smaller pool than the first.
sunday.earlyEnd: The club's own docs say a round always runs its full week and cannot be ended early. The relay publishes callable and earlyCall regardless; neither is republished here, and the relay is what the code reads.
sunday.costNote: Since round 6 (13 Sep 2026) the price follows the yacht’s grade, in proportion to its weight, so a point buys the same chance in every grade. /tide sends cost: null beside costLadder.
sunday.unfloated: A round that closes short of minCaptains is not drawn. Round 8 closed on 4 Oct 2026 with 2 captains; the relay opens the next round in its own time.

tide.dormant: No NFT in the club's prize wallet means no round opens at all. The relay says so in dormant and counts what is waiting in potCount.
tide._source: Live round at RELAY /tide, re-read 19 October 2026. The relay is authoritative; these are the fallback.

islands._idBaseSource: RELAY /islands idBase, read 14 Sep 2026: islandId = idBase + plot. Islands are tokens of this same contract; every yacht id is below it.
islands.gradeThresholdsNote: Lowest score of each grade, from RELAY /activation bands (Cay 10-20, Isle 21-45, Estate 46-75, Flagship 76-120). Score = the sum of the ten yachts’ Tide weights. The relay’s own grade on /islands always wins for a forged island; these only name a grade for a set nobody has forged yet (CLI pedigree).
islands._source: Live phase at RELAY /forge. Never trust these dates over the relay.
islands.wake: Score x 100 AP, paid once, stays with the token (RELAY /activation). An island earns score x 10 AP a day from the block it was forged, asleep or awake.

maxims: One yacht = full member, any class.
Capability scales with rarity. Access never does.
voice.header: LOG OF THE NORMIES YACHT CLUB ⛵️
voice.disclaimer: The club's own log. Every number is verifiable on-chain.

relay.note: The club’s own public relay - same service the marina reads. Fleet-wide and hull-keyed routes only.
relay.neverReadWhy: They are keyed by wallet. The club publishes no holder lists and neither does its log.
